step.name: F1Shim DMA simulation test
step.description: Run qdma_mm_firesim_test0 (already defined in tests_firesim.vh) in VCS against the full FireSim design. This test uses CED's TSK_QDMA_MM_H2C_TEST and TSK_QDMA_MM_C2H_TEST tasks to drive QDMA MM DMA through the NoC to PCIE_M_AXI → F1Shim io_pcis. The CED Option C ran similar DMA tests but to BRAM targets; this test validates DMA reaches F1Shim's DMA port. The QDMA MM destination address must route through the NoC axi_noc_0 aperture at 0x203_0000_0000 (the overall_fpga_top.v strips this base, passing lower 32 bits to io_pcis). Address map mismatches are the most likely failure mode.
success_criteria: qdma_mm_firesim_test0 runs in VCS against the F1Shim design
QDMA H2C (host-to-card) DMA transfer completes without timeout
QDMA C2H (card-to-host) DMA transfer completes without timeout
Test completes with PASSED status (no data compare errors)
No contention errors that prevent test completion (SecureIP contention warnings are expected and benign)

parts.description: Fix QDMA MM DMA descriptor card-side addresses to route through correct NoC aperture (0x203 instead of 0x201) and increase VCS simulation timeout for DMA transfers
parts.done_when: VCS compile completes successfully (exit=0) with no errors in usp_pci_exp_usrapp_tx.v compilation. The changes are: (A) In TSK_INIT_QDMA_MM_DATA_H2C (~line 8300), under an `ifdef FIRESIM_EP` guard, change DATA_STORE[H2C_ADDR+(k*32)+20] from 8'h01 to 8'h03 — this changes the H2C destination (card-side) address from 0x0201_0000_0000 to 0x0203_0000_0000 so it routes through axi_noc_0 MADDR1/DST1=0xC0 to M01_AXI NSU → PCIE_M_AXI → F1Shim io_pcis (DMA port). (B) In TSK_INIT_QDMA_MM_DATA_C2H (~line 8352), under the same `ifdef FIRESIM_EP` guard, change DATA_STORE[C2H_ADDR+(k*32)+4] from 8'h01 to 8'h03 — same fix for the C2H source (card-side) address. Without this fix, address 0x201 routes to M00_AXI (PCIE_M_AXI_LITE / BAR), not the DMA port. (C) In run_vcs.sh update_simulate_do(), increase runtime from 'run 2ms' to 'run 5ms' to accommodate DMA transfers that traverse NoC + F1Shim + DDR4 model latency.

parts.description: Run VCS simulation with qdma_mm_firesim_test0 and verify the full QDMA MM DMA H2C+C2H flow completes with PASSED status
parts.done_when: simulate.log (or simulate_full.log) contains 'qdma_mm_firesim_test0 PASSED' and the simulation reaches $finish. Key milestones to check in the log: (1) 'CDO programming done on both EP and RP', (2) 'SYSTEM CHECK PASSED' (PCIe link-up), (3) 'AXI-MM H2C Tests start' followed by 'AXI-MM H2C Completed' (H2C DMA without timeout), (4) 'AXI-MM C2H Tests start' with 'C2H Transfer Data MATCHES' followed by 'AXI-MM C2H Completed' (C2H DMA without data compare error), (5) 'qdma_mm_firesim_test0 PASSED'. If the test hangs (no $finish within 5ms), the most likely causes are: (a) DMA address still not routing correctly — check if PCIE_M_AXI awvalid/arvalid ever asserts, (b) F1Shim io_pcis not responding — check for X/Z on AXI response signals, (c) DDR4 path through axi_noc_1 not operational. SecureIP contention warnings ('contention on signal') from the CPM5 encrypted model are expected and benign — they do not indicate test failure.
